verdict.rationale: Scribe documents a per-request zero retention mode: setting enable_logging=false means request data isn't retained. That plausibly keeps customer audio and transcripts out of model training, but the evidence never explicitly ties this control to training-data use. Missing for 10: an explicit documented statement that customer data is not used for training (or a training opt-out setting), an account-level or default policy covering all requests, clarity on which plans can use zero retention, and independent corroboration.
